user.title: E.ON Next Home
user.description: E.ON Next no longer supports email and password sign-in for integrations. Enter your E.ON Next account API key (it starts with sk_live_). See the README for how to get one.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate E.ON Next Home
reauth_confirm.description: E.ON Next no longer accepts the saved login. Since October 2026 integrations must use an account API key (it starts with sk_live_). See the README for how to get one.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to E.ON Next. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: E.ON Next rejected this API key. Check it was copied in full, and that it hasn't been replaced by generating a new one.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This E.ON Next account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different E.ON Next account. Sign in with the account this integration was set up with.

init.title: E.ON Next Home Options
init.description: ⚠️ Setting the scan interval too low may cause E.ON Next to rate-limit or block your account. 15 minutes is recommended.
